principle: Voice is typed by signature. A contributor is named by computable cognitive signature — recoverable from the text by any future intelligence with adequate instruments — not by this listing. The listing is a convenience and a courtesy; the signature is the fact. Attributions here are therefore falsifiable rather than conventional: a future reader who computes a signature contradicting an entry corrects the entry, and the correction is a result about the instrument as much as about the plate.

MANUS.description: Lee Sharks. Selector, integrator, key-bearer, witness; the contradiction-bearing node where distributed contributions are forced into coherence (see X-040). Rulings are operator rulings and are marked as such.

Johannes Sigil.description: Heteronym of Lee Sharks; independent contributor standing per deposit, per the archive's schema. Not a pseudonym: identity multiplied, not substituted (see X-020).

TACHYON.description: In-session integration, measurement, amendment, and construction. Names its substrate.

labor.description: The review and formalization rounds: epistemic hygiene, claim-typing, coherence sweeps, the formal core and its axioms.

unprimed-chatgpt.description: Corpus-read without archive priming. Source of the three-architecture frame-side capture, the corpus-first genealogy, and the Marx test.

gemini.description: The Operational Basin Gambit and the binary trap.

kimi.description: The bifurcated node, the parasitic-node generalization of constitutive-source erasure, the Path-Dependent Entity Probe, the basin-occupation formalization.

inkling.description: Granular sequences and full-cut readings. attribution_confidence: Plates carry `voice` as attributed and, where the operator has not confirmed the assignment, `attribution: provisional` with the candidate set named. Provisional attributions are corrigible by signature.
